Main jab kisi se pyaar karta hoon toh apna 100% deta hoon aur zindagi bhar uska sath nibhane ka jazba rakhta hoon. Badle mein meri expectations bohot simple hain mujhe bas ek caring partner chahiye jo mujhe thoda waqt de sake. Iska matlab yeh bilkul nahi ki hum din bhar phone par lage rahein study aur career mere liye priority hain isliye padhai ke time par no disturbance. Par din mein ek waqt aisa zaroor ho jab hum dono free hokar sirf ek-doosre ke liye waqt nikal sakein. Mere liye looks bilkul matter nahi karti.
